name: Wadomari (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Wadomari town emblem in light blue and orange: a light blue ring with an orange disc at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Wadomari, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in January 1968.

features.role: Wadomari town emblem — a light blue ring with an orange disc at the top
